project.description: TEST-only E2E providers (R9 BE-16). Never packaged into the production jar: chengyinhub-admin depends on this module with test scope, and only the explicit Maven profile `e2e-test-providers` puts it on the runtime classpath for the TEST server. Each provider is additionally gated by the `e2e-test` Spring profile and `chengyin.e2e.test-providers=true`.
